concepts.quote: after the last line total is still 11.5, because it already has a value.
concepts.why: States a rule contradicting Java: an assignment to a double variable replaces its value (total becomes 12.42, confirmed by the run), so a variable 'already having a value' does not block reassignment; the correct 11.5 is only a bare result.

concepts.quote: total is still 11.5, because it already has a value
concepts.why: Treats the total as a fixed quantity that exists once set, denying the read-combine-store-back update of total = total + total * TAX, which the run shows yields 12.42.
